summary: rakita 提交 EIP-8374：调用帧回滚或异常终止时不再回滚 `accessed_addresses` 和 `accessed_storage_keys`，一旦 warm 就在整笔交易内保持 warm，让 gas 定价与客户端实际成本一致。Ben Adams 提交 EIP-8375，为 ePBS 统一 MEV 销毁。Barnabé 回顾 quick slots 陈述，下一步与 Sourcify 排查依赖 slot 时间的已部署合约。以太坊官方账号转发 Coin Center 关于隐私的长帖，Vitalik 评论 Signal 免手机号注册。

items.title: 新 EIP：回滚时保留 warm 访问集
items.note: （rakita）提交，Magicians 讨论帖 16:00。修改 EIP-2929 行为，调用帧回滚或异常终止时不再回滚 `accessed_addresses` 与 `accessed_storage_keys`。PR 的理由：回滚并不会把已经加载进客户端缓存的数据清掉，定价应与实际成本一致；访问集变成只追加，也不再需要日志回滚，实现更简单。
items.title_en: New EIP: persist warm access sets across reverts
items.note_en: (rakita), submitted, with a Magicians thread at 16:00. It amends EIP-2929 so `accessed_addresses` and `accessed_storage_keys` are not rolled back on call-frame revert or exceptional halt. The PR's reasoning: a revert does not evict data already loaded into client caches, so pricing should match actual cost, and append-only access sets remove the need for journal rollback, simplifying implementations.

items.title: 新 EIP：ePBS 强制销毁执行奖励
items.note: （benaadams）提交，即 EIP-8375。对每个执行载荷（包括自建块）按配置比例销毁总优先费，并把外部构建者 `gross_value` 的同一比例作为拍卖销毁目标。
items.title_en: New EIP: ePBS mandatory burn of execution rewards
items.note_en: (benaadams), submitted, now EIP-8375. It burns a configured fraction of aggregate priority fees on every executed payload, including self-builds, and treats the same fraction of an external builder's `gross_value` as an auction burn target.

summary_en: rakita submitted EIP-8374: when a call frame reverts or halts exceptionally, `accessed_addresses` and `accessed_storage_keys` are no longer rolled back, so anything warmed stays warm for the rest of the transaction and gas pricing matches what clients actually pay. Ben Adams submitted EIP-8375, a unified MEV burn for ePBS. Barnabé reviewed his quick slots presentation; the next step is working with Sourcify to find deployed contracts that rely on slot time. The official Ethereum account ran a Coin Center guest thread on privacy, and Vitalik commented on Signal registration without a phone number.
